title: CPSC, Hunter Fan Co. Announce Recall of Humidifiers
summary: The motors in these humidifiers can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 100,000.

title: CPSC, Longwell Electronics Announce Recall of Power Cord Sets Sold with HP Inkjet Printers
summary: The connector can break, exposing electrical contacts and posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: CPSC, Trudeau Corp. Announce Recall of Fondue Sets
summary: The plastic ring with handles, that is attached to the upper rim of the fondue pot, can crack during normal heating or cooling, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Murray Inc. Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: The fuel tank can crack and leak fuel, posing a burn or fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 89,500.

title: CPSC, Dixon Industries Inc. Announce Recall of Riding Lawn Mowers
summary: The fuel tanks on these mowers can crack and leak fuel, posing a fire hazard and risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 28,000.

title: CPSC, Exmark Manufacturing Announce Recall of Riding Mowers
summary: The riding mower's exhaust system can ignite fuel vapors from spilled fuel if the engine backfires. Units: About 21,000.

title: CPSC, The Toro Company Announce Recall of Riding Mowers
summary: The riding mower's exhaust system can ignite fuel vapors from spilled fuel if the engine backfires. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Dollar Tree Stores Inc. Announce Recall of Paperweights
summary: The paperweights can leak petroleum distillates, which can pose ingestion and flammability hazards to consumers. Units: About 165,000.

title: CPSC, Jade Products Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Dynasty Gas Ranges
summary: The ranges could tip-over if a heavy weight is placed on an open oven door, posing a risk of burn injuries from hot food or liquids in cooking containers. Units: About 7,200.

title: CPSC, Pascal Products Co. Announce Recall of Two-Paneled Fireplace Screens Sold At Wal-Mart
summary: The paint on the metal mesh can ignite when exposed to a direct flame, posing a serious fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: CPSC, ICON Health & Fitness Inc. Announce Recall of Hiker Exercise Equipment
summary: An electrical component in the control system at the base of the unit can fail and cause overheating. This poses a risk of fire and burns to consumers. Units: About 7,500.

title: CPSC, Rose Art Announce Recall of Children's Soap Making Kit
summary: The soap may get too hot when heated in the microwave oven and leak from the plastic container, posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 124,000.

title: CPSC and GE Interlogix Announce Recall to Repair Security Control Panels
summary: The systems can fail to communicate with the central station that should receive the distress signal, which then would fail to alert the fire department, police department, or ambulance service. This poses a safety risk to consumers. Units: Approximately 18,000.

title: CPSC, Viessmann Manufacturing Company (U.S.) Inc., Announce Recall of SR-RN-2 and SR-RN2R Boiler Control
summary: The controls have an electronic relay that may fail in a manner that will allow the burner to operate and by-pass the interlock with the flue damper. The interlock assures proper operation of the damper for removal of combustion gases. If the interlock fails, excess carbon monoxide emissions may occ

title: CPSC, Leiner Health Products Announce Recall of Dietary Supplements Containing Iron
summary: The supplements being recalled are not packaged in child-resistant packaging, as required under the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. If ingested by children, these iron-containing supplements can cause serious injury or death. Units: About 14,000.

title: CPSC and Tristar Products Inc. Announce Recall of Steam Cleaner
summary: The internal hose connected to the trigger in the handle can detach, allowing hot water and/or steam to escape, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,100.

title: CPSC, Lifetime Products Inc. and Escalade Sports Announce Recall to Repair Portable Basketball Hoops
summary: The basketball hoops may have a sharp protruding bolt on the players' side of the pole, that can cause serious leg or body lacerations to consumers, when the bolt is exposed. Units: About 1.7 million Lifetime portable hoops, and about 16,000 Escalade portable hoops.

title: CPSC, Tough Traveler Ltd. Announce Recall of Child Backpack Carriers
summary: A child could fall from a carrier when the seat restraint strap is not doubled-back through the slider if the carrier's safety harness is not used. The seat restraint strap is located between the child's legs when the child is seated. Units: 135.

title: CPSC, Childcraft Education Corp. Announce Recall of Changing Table with Steps
summary: When one of the front doors is open, a child's finger can become stuck inside spaces between parts of the hinges, causing finger crushing or pinching to occur while the door is closing. Units: About 700.

title: CPSC, Invensys Climate Controls Announce Recall of TS11 Thermal Safety Control Valve
summary: The lower body, with 1/4", 3/8", 7/16" inlet/outlet diameter, may have a machining defect that can create a thin wall on the bottom of the casting.
